findings.message: After the new generic /v1 segment strip this endsWith("/v1") trim is dead code: the regex /\/v1(\/|$)/ already matches a trailing /v1, so any pathname ending in /v1 is cut by the slice on the line above and the next line can never observe one. Removing it keeps normalizeBaseUrl honest about its one normalization rule.
findings.patch_old:
if (v1Index >= 0) pathname = pathname.slice(0, v1Index);
  if (pathname.endsWith("/v1")) pathname = pathname.slice(0, -3);

findings.message: The comment says the 45ms stream succeeds only because each chunk resets the stall budget, but the budget is 60ms: the stream completes at about 30-45ms even if the stall timer were armed once and never reset, so a regression that removed the per-progress poke would still pass. Tighten the budget below the total stream duration (for example 20ms against sends at 0/15/30ms) and align the comment so
findings.evidence: // Total 45ms with 15ms gaps: succeeds only when each chunk resets a 25ms budget.

findings.message: The welcome screen unconditionally says "Connected to <baseUrl>. Ask anything..." before any connection has been confirmed, while the status bar in the same view can read "Offline · check Settings" after refreshModels fails, so the two UI signals contradict each other on an unreachable server.
findings.evidence: box.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement("p"), { className: "muted", textContent: `Connected to ${state.settings.baseUrl}. Ask anything, or start with one of these.` }));
